description: This Java class named CollateralManagementHelper contains helper methods for managing collateral-related operations in integration tests for the Fineract project. It provides functions to create, update, and retrieve collateral and collateral product data via REST API calls, utilizing the RestAssured library and JSON serialization. The class is marked with deprecation notices indicating a transition towards a different client library.

classes.name: CollateralManagementHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing collateral-related API operations within integration tests for Apache Fineract.

methods.name: createClientCollateral
methods.description: Creates a new collateral entry for a specific client using a POST request.

methods.name: getClientCollateralData
methods.description: Retrieves data about a specific collateral for a client via a GET request.

methods.name: clientCollateralAsJson
methods.description: Generates a JSON string representing collateral data with specified ID and quantity.

methods.name: createCollateralProduct
methods.description: Creates a new collateral product configuration via POST request.

methods.name: collateralProductAsJson
methods.description: Converts collateral product attributes into a JSON string.

methods.name: updateCollateralProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing collateral product using a PUT request.

methods.name: updateCollateralProductAsString
methods.description: Updates collateral product and extracts the 'pctToBase' value from response JSON.

methods.name: updateCollateralProductAsJson
methods.description: Generates a JSON string to update collateral product data.

methods.name: updateClientCollateral
methods.description: Updates a client's collateral, creating a client first and then performing the update.

methods.name: updateClientCollateralAsString
methods.description: Performs collateral update and extracts the 'quantity' value from the response JSON.

methods.name: updateClientCollateralAsJson
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for updating client collateral quantity.
